newsitem.title: USA: Stocks soar; Dow sets another record high.
newsitem.headline: Stocks soar; Dow sets another record high.

text.p: Blue-chip stocks rocketed Monday, lifting the Dow Jones industrial average to another record high as Wall Street bet that the Federal Reserve will keep interest rates unchanged at a policy-setting meeting next week.

Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow closed up 123.63 points, or 1.72 percent, at 7,293.16, beating by a wide margin its May 6 record finish of 7,225.32. In the broader market, advancing issues beat declines by a 2-1 margin on moderate volume of about 462 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
